name: Understand Then Build
description: Investigates existing or unfamiliar code first, then runs the full idea-to-commit pipeline on top of what was learned -- a composed chain built from the canonical idea-to-committed playbook, terminating at the commit.
examples: help me understand this codebase first, then plan a change here, build it, and commit it
investigate this existing code, then take an idea through planning, implementation, and a commit
look into what's already here, then brainstorm a fix, build it, and commit the work
onboard me to this project and then walk a new idea from planning through to a committed change
